نتصابر (form VI)
# نَتَصَابَرُ (nataṣābaru) /na.ta.sˤaː.ba.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَصَابَرَ (taṣābara)
# نَتَصَابَرَ (nataṣābara) /na.ta.sˤaː.ba.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَصَابَرَ (taṣābara)
# نَتَصَابَرْ (nataṣābar) /na.ta.sˤaː.bar/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَصَابَرَ (taṣābara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
